nodes.summary: The decision problem 3-SAT WITH BOUNDED OCCURRENCES accepts a bitstring $x$ exactly when $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding of bounded-occurrence 3-SAT instances, to an instance that is well formed and satisfiable; it rejects every other bitstring, including every bitstring that does not decode.
nodes.title: 3-SAT with bounded occurrences as a decision problem

nodes.summary: A bounded-occurrence 3-SAT instance $(n, \varphi)$ is satisfiable when there is a list $(a_0, \dots, a_{n-1})$ of booleans such that $\varphi$ is satisfied by the assignment sending each variable $x < n$ to $a_x$ and every variable $x \ge n$ to false.
nodes.title: Satisfiable bounded-occurrence 3-SAT instances

nodes.summary: A bounded-occurrence 3-SAT instance is a pair $(n, \varphi)$ of a natural number $n$, the number of variables, and a CNF formula $\varphi$.
nodes.title: Bounded-occurrence 3-SAT instances

nodes.summary: The decision problem 3-SAT WITH BOUNDED OCCURRENCES over bitstrings belongs to NP, and every decision problem in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to it.
nodes.title: 3-SAT WITH BOUNDED OCCURRENCES is NP-complete

nodes.summary: A bounded-occurrence 3-SAT instance $(n, \varphi)$ is well formed when every clause of $\varphi$ is a list of exactly three literals, not necessarily distinct, every literal of $\varphi$ has a variable less than $n$, and for every variable $v < n$ at most four of the literals in the clauses of $\varphi$, counted with multiplicity and with either polarity, have variable $v$.
nodes.title: Well-formed bounded-occurrence 3-SAT instances

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
